parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 reduced val_bpb from 1.001203 to 0.986129. Capacity is paying off significantly even with the higher parameter count. Next, I'll try slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to see if we can push the learning further with this larger model.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 to optimize the larger model's learning rate.
